episodes.title: The Merge: Part 1
episodes.summary: After a mysterious event known as "The Merge" shuffles the universe, an aspiring Ninja teams with a smart techie to navigate a new and unfamiliar world.

episodes.title: The Merge: Part 2
episodes.summary: Arin and Sora develop new powers that just might help them confront the dragon hunters. Can the Green Ninja teach them how to harness their abilities?

episodes.title: Crossroads Carnival
episodes.summary: On training day, Arin and Sora sneak out of the monastery to attend the Crossroads Carnival and uncover a villainous plot that tests their skills.

episodes.title: Beyond Madness
episodes.summary: When the Bounty airship returns with no captain, Arin, Sora and Lloyd use clues to figure out what happened to Kai. Is it a trap... or something worse?

episodes.title: Writers of Destiny
episodes.summary: To save Cloud Kingdom, the Ninja must work together to send a terrifying tentacled beast back where it came from and close the Mergequake — and fast!

episodes.title: Return to Imperium
episodes.summary: When the Ninja meet their match in a Photac — an indestructible techno-beast — Sora believes that a mission to Imperium is the only way to destroy it.

episodes.title: Mindless Beasts
episodes.summary: In Imperium, Arin mentors a group of eager young crimefighters. Sora confronts a villain from her past. Lloyd frees an Elemental Master from prison.

episodes.title: I Will Be the Danger
episodes.summary: To bust the imprisoned dragons out of Imperium, the Ninja will need to work hard, think fast and find one big exit! Unless the Photacs get there first.

episodes.title: The Calm Inside
episodes.summary: Sora hacks into the Imperium logs to find Riyu. Nya and Kai explore a mysterious passageway. Lloyd leads an epic battle against an army of Photacs.

episodes.title: The Battle of the Second Monastery
episodes.summary: Ninja never quit! Nya, Kai and Zane give the battle against Imperium new hope while Lloyd uncovers a mystery hidden deep below the city.

episodes.title: The Temple of the Dragon Cores
episodes.summary: To stop the MergeQuakes from getting worse, the Ninja travel to the Temple of the Dragon Cores to learn more about something called "The Coalescence."

episodes.title: Gangs of the Sea
episodes.summary: When the Ninja split up to find the three Dragon Cores, Arin and Lloyd take the airship but soon need help from a village of peaceful algae farmers.

episodes.title: Wyldly Inappropriate
episodes.summary: Mr. Frohicky and Zane head to the Crossroads to locate a Wyconium coil. Elsewhere, Wyldfyre's pranks complicate her and Kai's Dragon Core quest.

episodes.title: The Last Djinn
episodes.summary: Nya's Seeker Stones lead her and Sora to something they weren't searching for. As Zane's Assistant Keeper, Mr. Frohicky can't do anything right.

episodes.title: They Call it Doom
episodes.summary: Sora and Nya search for the Dragon Core with a magical compass. Arin and Lloyd get put to the test in Mother Garden. Wyldfyre and Kai play keep-away.

episodes.title: Land of Lost Things
episodes.summary: In the Land of Lost Things, Nya runs into an old pal while Sora looks for an alternate power source to ward off a junkyard monster called "The Hoarder."

episodes.title: The Administration
episodes.summary: Lloyd and Arin arrive in the Administration, where they learn the Dragon Core will be demolished if they don't act fast — and file the correct paperwork.

episodes.title: Absolute Power
episodes.summary: While the Ninja try to figure out a way to bypass Imperium's energy barrier, Empress Beatrix tests a deadly weapon powered by stolen Dragon Cores.

episodes.title: We are all Dragons
episodes.summary: To expose Empress Beatrix's mistreatment of dragons to the naïve citizens of Imperium, the Ninja will need help... from a man on the inside.

episodes.title: The Power Within
episodes.summary: Empress Beatrix's rampage pushes the MergeQuakes dangerously close to the tipping point, unless the Ninja can work together — and save the world.

episodes.title: The Blood Moon
episodes.summary: Arin and Sora investigate a mysterious break-in at the junkyard while a sleep-deprived Lloyd suffers from stress dreams about warriors wearing masks.

episodes.title: Shattered Dreams
episodes.summary: The Ninja interrogate a shifty shopkeeper about a stolen mallet. Could the ancient tool be connected to the Cloud Kingdom archives — and Lloyd's visions?

episodes.title: Beyond the Phantasm Cave
episodes.summary: A metal gate. A teacher. And a direction...? Lloyd experiences a vision from the Source Dragons that sends the Ninja on a righteous but unclear quest.

episodes.title: Force From the East
episodes.summary: To meet the legendary teacher from Lloyd's visions, the Ninja must pass a series of tests. But will the ancient master live up to their expectations?

episodes.title: The Spell at the Waterfall
episodes.summary: The Ninja begin their training to defeat the Forbidden Five, but Wyldfyre feels left behind. Bonzle reveals an unexpected connection.

episodes.title: To Mysterium
episodes.summary: Bonzle and her team set out to search for a certain sorceress, but first they'll need a map. Meanwhile, Arin struggles with his Spinjitzu training.

episodes.title: Fugitive from Madness
episodes.summary: With the Blood Moon looming, Bonzle asks her eccentric creator for help while the Ninja have one last chance to master the Rising Dragon technique.

episodes.title: Secrets of the Wyldness
episodes.summary: The Ninja head to the Wyldness, where they must confront Lord Ras — whether they're ready or not. Sorceress reveals her plan for keeping Bonzle safe.

episodes.title: The Forest of the Spirits
episodes.summary: Sorceress searches the storehouse for a spell to rescue Bonzle while Arin intercepts a special package. Then, the remaining Ninja infiltrate the ritual.

episodes.title: Rising Ninja
episodes.summary: With the sacrifices, spell and Blood Moon in his control, Lord Ras has everything he needs to unleash the Forbidden Five — unless the Ninja can act fast!

episodes.title: The Shape of Motion
episodes.summary: Lloyd attempts to decipher his visions, while Arin uncovers a mysterious theft that threatens the Sixteen Realms while searching for his parents.

episodes.title: Enter the City of Temples
episodes.summary: The Ninja get a big surprise when they arrive at the Tournament of the Sources, while Kai and Bonzle contend with the Forbidden Five in the Nether-Space.

episodes.title: They Gather for the Feast
episodes.summary: Arin runs into an old friend at the Tournament of the Sources, the Ninja explore the City of Temples, and Lloyd sees a strangely familiar face.

episodes.title: Inside the Maze
episodes.summary: Master Wu sets out to discipline the Ninja — through dance! Arin reunites with Frak, who Sora doesn't trust, and the fighting gets underway.

episodes.title: United We Fall
episodes.summary: Nerves fray and tempers flare as the Ninja prepare to compete. Wyldfyre squares off against Cinder, leading to a serious setback for the gang.

episodes.title: Truth and Lies
episodes.summary: As the Ninja fight to win the Temple Race, Ras makes a shocking claim to Arin — putting him at odds with his friends — just as the tournament heats up.

episodes.title: The Sword Shatters
episodes.summary: Kai makes a discovery that allows him to speak with his sister. Arin visits the Temple City museum where he has a breakthrough about the missing horns.

episodes.title: Clues and Suspects
episodes.summary: Wyldfyre teams up with Arin to find out if Roby is behind the stolen horns. Later, at Bleckt's office, they make a startling discovery.

episodes.title: The Final Game
episodes.summary: Master Wu confirms Arin's worst fears, and the location of the horns comes to light. Later, Wyldfyre drops a truth bomb at the tournament.

episodes.title: Elements of Betrayal
episodes.summary: The Wolf Mask army battles the Elemental Masters as the Ninja converge on the Monastery of Gates to stop Nokt from freeing the Forbidden Five.

episodes.title: The Missing
episodes.summary: Sora's pie-baking failure gives Zane an idea for how to find Arin, and the crew frees a village from a giant puppet's reign of terror on the way.

episodes.title: The Ultimate Object of Admiration
episodes.summary: The search for Arin — who continues his training with Ras — leads the Ninja into a dangerous confrontation with a ferocious cyclops.

episodes.title: The Spectral Lands
episodes.summary: In the Spectral Lands, Ras sends Arin to retrieve a healing elixir from the Well of the Lost. Kai hatches an ingenious plan to find Jay.

episodes.title: The Great Zane Robbery
episodes.summary: Zane's run-in with looters at a strange monastery leads to a reunion with an old friend, but he also crosses paths with one of the Forbidden Five.

episodes.title: I Alone Can Save Them
episodes.summary: The reunited Ninja learn of the Forbidden Five's dangerous quest to find the Prismatic Blades. Meanwhile, Ras leads Arin across a desert.

episodes.title: Fallen Wishes
episodes.summary: Arrakore the djinn transports Sora, Nya and Riyu to New Djinjago. Ras enlists Arin in his plan to reverse the Merge.

episodes.title: Their Draconic Majesty's Request
episodes.summary: A mysterious mercenary attacks Ras and Arin in the World Forest. Zane and P.I.X.A.L. try a new approach in their search for the Prismatic Blades.

episodes.title: Crashing Together
episodes.summary: The Ninja catch up with Arin in the World Forest and try to convince him to leave Ras, and the reason for Arin and Sora's deep bond is revealed.

episodes.title: Chaos Unchained
episodes.summary: Heavily outnumbered, the Ninja race to stop the Forbidden Five from freeing Thunderfang. Wyldfyre desperately tries to cure one of the crew.

episodes.title: The Shatter Dragon
episodes.summary: Lloyd attracts the attention of a powerful adversary. The intervention of the mysterious mercenary tips the balance in an epic battle.

episodes.title: The Hollow Ones
episodes.summary: ThunderFang is freed, and only the Ninja stand between the Shatter Dragon of Chaos and his revenge.

episodes.title: Human Resources
episodes.summary: With Mysterium under attack, Ras, Arin and Sora rely on the Sorceress for help, while Jay leads the Ninja to the Administration on their way to Lee.

episodes.title: Between You and Lee
episodes.summary: Lloyd, Jay, Nya and Wyldfyre go undercover in the strange Land of Lee, while Riyu's training under Rontu is off to a bumpy start.

episodes.title: Casket of Bones
episodes.summary: The Underworld tests Arin and Sora's commitment to Ras, while Nya and Jay work together to expose Lee's secret.

episodes.title: The Screaming Earth
episodes.summary: Cole, Frak and Kai unearth a shocking discovery outside the Land of Lost Things, while the Ninja reunite to liberate Lee.

episodes.title: Under the Light of a Mechanical Moon
episodes.summary: The Ninja escape Lee and head for the source of the threat, while Ras plans his next move.

episodes.title: The Vault of Focus
episodes.summary: In the City of Temples, the Ninja find guidance from an unlikely source, while Cole, Kai and Frak battle the Hollow Ones in Imperium.

episodes.title: For Whom the Bell Tolls
episodes.summary: The Ninja embark on their separate journeys to awaken the Arc Dragon of Focus but deal with unexpected - and annoying - interruptions.

episodes.title: When Doves Cry
episodes.summary: The Ninja reach the Caves of Bells while Lloyd and Arin fight their way through the Spectral Lands to summon the Arc Dragon.

episodes.title: Chaos Reigns
episodes.summary: ThunderFang gathers the last of his power in the Spectral Lands and only the Ninja can stop him - but at what cost?

episodes.title: The Whispering Wood
episodes.summary: Scattered, the Ninja are lost in unknown realms! Lloyd and Arin find themselves in the mysterious Whispering Wood where they battle strange Elemental Monsters and encounter a protector of the forest who has a stunning revelation for Lloyd. Meanwhile, the young Ninja find themselves in a peaceful place... maybe too peaceful. Stuck in a distant cave, Jay opens up to Nya and Kai about his path ahead.

episodes.title: The Lean of a Tree
episodes.summary: While in the Whispering Wood, Lloyd learns the secrets of the Green Ninja and why he may have missed his calling. Meanwhile, the young Ninja fall victim to the siren call of the mysterious land where they are stranded. And while Jay, Nya and Kai fight dangers outside this mysterious new Monastery, Jay determines that it's time he faces his forgotten past.

episodes.title: Tonight We Hunt Monsters
episodes.summary: The young Ninja, desperate to get back home, must protect the bumbling explorers for the monster they are trying to catch. Nya and Kai aid in Jay's quest to unlock his memories, which leads them back to the Administration. The Whispering Wood is under siege, and the Loyalists search for the Weapon of Desolation!

episodes.title: A Wonder of the Merged Lands
episodes.summary: Jay, Nya and Kai are on the threshold of restoring Jay's memories inside the Administration. In the Whispering Wood, Lloyd trusts his connection to guide him to the Temple of the Green Ninja. The others are doubtful until unexpected help arrives. Meanwhile, Sora, Frak, Wyldfyre and Riyu deal with the aftermath of the monster attack which draws them into conflict with the Explorer's Club.

episodes.title: Seed and Soil
episodes.summary: Lloyd enters the Temple of the Green Ninja, but what he finds inside shocks him - maybe he won't survive the trial. Meanwhile, Sora, Frak and Wyldfyre are under attack in Umbrasylvis with their friend's life hanging in the balance. Back in Ninjago, the Loyalists draw closer to their goal and their leader is revealed.

episodes.title: Just Under the Surface
episodes.summary: While escaping the Administration, Nya, Kai and Jay stumble onto a Loyalist plot. Meanwhile, Arin and the others defend the Whispering Wood while Lloyd completes his trial. Back in Ninjago, Cole investigates an attack in the city, and across the Merged Lands, Sora's team is held captive in Umbrasilvis until the masked stranger is found.

episodes.title: The Grand Inquisition
episodes.summary: In order to clear their names and leave Umbrasylvis, Sora and Frak must unmask the Loyalist in the Explorer's Club ranks, but Frak's past clouds his judgment. Arin and the other Ninja tend to the Whispering Wood as its protector whithers - will Lloyd be too late? Inside the Temple of the Green Ninja, an unlikely guide helps Lloyd untangle his choices from his destiny.

episodes.title: Dying to Live
episodes.summary: Cole finds himself in Loyalist headquarters with a clue to their ultimate goal. He attempts to single-handedly foil the plot with unexpected consequences for his Elemental Power. Meanwhile, Lloyd faces the ultimate test in the Temple of the Green Ninja, and the fate of the Whispering Wood and the entire Merged Lands hangs in the balance.

episodes.title: The Heartbeat of all the Realms
episodes.summary: The Loyalists march from Ninjago with the Weapon of Desolation in hand. Their leader raises an army of Elemental Monsters, and not even the Ninja, finally reunited, are a match for them. Meanwhile, Lloyd exits the Temple of the Green Ninja with new knowledge and powers, but his duty to the Whispering Wood might prevent him from saving the entire Merged Lands.

episodes.title: Birthright
episodes.summary: The Loyalists and their Elemental Monster army take their battle into the streets, and the Ninja cannot combat the threat. A last minute ally delivers hope and turns the tide of battle - but will it be enough? Without the Source Dragons on their side, the Ninja must rely on each other to save the Merged Lands.
